artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Child
artworks.medium: ambrotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an adult and a child, posed together, in a portrait from the waist up. The adult is seated, with their right arm around the child. The adult has short, neatly-combed dark hair, deep-set eyes, and a serious expression. They are dressed in a dark suit jacket, a white shirt, and a bow tie. The child, also seated, has long light hair that is combed back. They are wearing a light-colored dress with frilled sleeves and dark patterns on the front. The adult’s hand rests on the arm of the chair, which is upholstered in a richly patterned fabric. The photograph has an ornate golden frame with intricate scrolling patterns typical of antique framing. The background is plain, putting the focus on the subjects.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman and Two Girls
artworks.medium: ambrotype with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three people in a portrait format within an ornate, golden frame. The central figure, an adult woman, sits with two young girls on either side. She is positioned facing the camera directly, with dark hair, a serious expression, and wears a plaid shawl over a plaid dress with a light-colored scarf around her neck. The child on the left wears a dark-patterned dress with a lace collar and cuffs, while the child on the right sports a pink dress with similar lace trim and braided hair. The background is a plain, light color.

artworks.title: Das Schloss am Meer (Castle on the Sea)
artworks.medium: oil sketch with pen and brown ink over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a painting of a wooded area with a castle-like structure in the distance. The perspective suggests the observer is among the trees. The landscape leads to the distant building under a moonlit night sky. The brushstrokes are refined, creating smooth transitions of tones that give depth to the scene. The structure stands out against the sky. The color palette is dark, with blues and grays, highlighted by moonlight reflecting on water and a small figure in red near a tree. The artwork has an intricate border, adding to its decorative style and mysterious ambiance.

artworks.title: The Great Thistle (Le Grand Chardon)
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé
artworks.description: The image displays large, detailed thistle plants with spiky leaves and stems topped with buds. It is a monochromatic etching with shades of black and white. In the foreground, thistle plants are on the right side, while smaller grasses and a dirt path are on the left, leading into the background with distant clouds.

artworks.title: Democritus
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with ruins and figures. The scene depicts a seated male figure draped in fabric, holding one arm to his forehead. Surrounding him are architectural elements like columns and stone blocks. In the background, a second figure, likely a classical statue, stands with an arm outstretched. The environment is overgrown with plants and a tree. The composition has detailed linework and shading.

artworks.title: A Corner of a Meadow with Fountaingrass
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor and gouache on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a view of a scene filled with large tufts of grass and greenery. The horizon is not visible, as the view is filled with the detailed depiction of grass in the foreground, leading to dense foliage in the distance. Brushstrokes create movement and texture, especially in the grass, with curves and sweeps depicting the natural flow of plant life. The color palette includes rich greens, varying from dark shadows to vibrant highlights, giving the composition a lively visual appeal.

artworks.title: Fantasy on the Villa Medici with Fountains
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a grand architectural scene viewed from a lower angle. The building and staircases dominate the composition with their ornate design. The drawing style uses fine lines and washes to highlight the intricate details of the structure and figures. The color palette is monochromatic, primarily using shades of gray and brown. In the foreground, a group of people socialize on the steps, one holding a parasol. In the background, there is a detailed facade of the building and an impressive rotunda. The drawing also includes sculptures and water features, along with a tree on the left side.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man nailed to a wooden cross in an upright position. His arms are outstretched and nailed at the wrists to the horizontal beam, while his feet are overlapped and nailed to the vertical post. The man is muscular, wearing a loincloth, a crown of thorns on his head, and shoulder-length curly hair. His facial features include a beard and a downward gaze. There is an inscription above his head on the cross in various languages. At the foot of the cross, there are skulls and bones. The background shows a cloudy sky with distant buildings or structures on the horizon.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of an elderly man who is seated, leaning over an open book on a table. His head is slightly bowed as he peers through a pair of spectacles held to his eyes with one hand. He has a long, flowing beard and a bald head with some hair at the sides and back. His facial expression is one of concentration. The man is wearing a loose robe, and there is a halo depicted around his head. To his side, there appears to be a crucifix, and around him are some thick foliage and branches. The background features a simple, textured design with some natural elements and a bird flying directly behind him.

artworks.title: The Madonna Nursing the Christ Child
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting and holding an infant. The woman looks down at the child in her arms. The woman has a serene expression and is wearing a headscarf. The infant has a small amount of hair and is facing away from the viewer. The woman is wearing draped clothing with detailed folds. A halo is drawn around the woman's head. The background has radiating lines, and there is inscribed text at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Saint Francis of Assisi
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image illustrates a person seated on the ground, leaning slightly forward. The individual has a long beard and unkempt hair, and appears thoughtful. They are wearing a long robe, holding a wooden cross while a skull rests on their lap. The background shows trees, foliage, rocks, and a sky with a radiant halo effect around the person's head.

artworks.title: The Madonna of the Swallow
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman holding a book, facing to the right. A child with curly hair sits in her lap playing with their foot. Another child, partially obscured, is next to her. The woman and children are near a tree stump. In the background, a man leads a donkey through a pathway bordered by trees and foliage.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper mounted on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows two adults and an infant. The woman on the left is sitting on the ground with her legs extended, holding a small child. The man on the right is facing forward, holding an open book. The background features a hilly landscape with trees and fields.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated with his upper body and part of his lower body visible. He has a long beard and curly hair, and is wearing a draped cloth. He is surrounded by objects, including a cross, a skull, and a book with an inkpot nearby. The background features dense foliage. The image has a textured, detailed quality.

artworks.title: Susanna and the Elders
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 31.8 x 31.1 cm (12 1/2 x 12 1/4 in.) cut within platemark
artworks.description: This print features three figures: a woman seated with her legs bent beneath her, a man with a bushy beard and long hair, and another man with a bald head and full beard. The seated woman is nude but attempts to cover herself with a bunch of fabric as she looks over her shoulder towards the two men. The men wear robes and are leaning over a fence looking at her; one gestures towards her while the other points away. The background includes trees and a distant hilly landscape with a far-away building. In the bottom right corner is a large fountain carved with a cherubic figure with water flowing into the pool at the bottom.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with an Angel
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 9.2 x 9.1 cm (3 5/8 x 3 9/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a woman holding a child. The woman is positioned close to the child, with her head slightly tilted down towards the child. Her facial features appear soft and serene, with long hair covered by a headscarf tied at the back. She is wearing a long garment with a flowing design, and her arms are cradling the child gently. The child, who appears to be an infant, is swaddled in cloth and peacefully resting in the woman's arms. Beside the woman, an angel with curly hair and feathered wings is visible. In the background, there is a textured pattern created by fine lines suggesting a halo effect behind the woman’s head. The image has text in the upper left corner, which appears to be an inscription or signature.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child with an Apple
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 15.1 x 11 cm (5 15/16 x 4 5/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.description: The image shows a woman holding a child. The woman has her head tilted towards the child, with a serene expression. She has detailed facial features and curly hair, with a nimbus around her head. The woman wears a garment with a ruffled neckline and a drape covering her. The unclothed child faces towards the woman and is nestled in her arms. The background has horizontal lines, creating a minimal setting that directs focus on the figures.

artworks.title: Venus and a Satyr
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure surrounded by two others. The scene depicts a nude figure reclining on a richly-draped bed surrounded by fabric and cushions. An elderly figure leans over from the left, grasping a piece of cloth, while a small winged child gestures towards the reclining figure. The backdrop reveals a pastoral landscape visible through a window or open area, punctuated by trees and distant hills. The use of linework and shading is intricate, conveying a sense of texture and depth to both figures and surroundings.

artworks.title: Pieta (the "Christ of Caprarola")
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing four figures, three of whom are seated, engaged in a scene with a reclining figure in their midst. The reclining figure is centrally positioned, showcasing his torso and legs. His head is tilted to one side, with long hair cascading down, and his eyes are closed. He is bare-chested, with a cloth draped over his lower body. The person directly behind him cradles his head tenderly while their head rests against his. Another figure to the left has curly hair and appears engaged in conversation with the figure on the far left, who has long hair. The background features a tree and brush-like textures, suggesting an outdoor setting. The artist's signature and date are etched near the bottom of the engraving.

artworks.title: The Madonna della Scodella
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image portrays four figures, mainly shown from the waist up. There is a central child held by a woman on the right. Another child is kneeling on the left side, offering a cup to the seated child. An older woman is seated behind them, looking forward with her right hand raised. The background features shaded horizontal lines, adding texture to the setting.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 18 x 2.6 cm (7 1/16 x 1 in.) cut to platemark
artworks.description: The image shows three figures with full bodies mainly depicted from the knees upward. The central figure, seated and slightly bowing their head, is positioned between two other figures who appear to be standing. This person has curly hair and a beard, and they wear a long robe. The figure to the left is wearing a helmet and armored clothing; they have a rugged expression with a broad face and a thick beard. On the right, another standing person with disheveled hair and a beard holds a reed or stick pointed at the central figure. Their muscular arm is visible, and they wear a loose garment. The setting is minimal with a plain background made up of horizontal and vertical lines, suggestive of a wall or structure. The artwork's etched lines and shading offer a textured and detailed look at both figures and their surroundings.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered around a baby in a manger. The scene is intricately detailed, depicting several individuals in a barn or stable setting. To the left, there are several figures with animal skins draped over them, who appear to be observing and gesturing in awe or reverence towards the central figure of the baby resting on a bed of straw. To the right, a kneeling figure is reaching out towards the baby across from a wooden support beam or post, dividing the composition. Behind this kneeling figure, additional figures, including one with animal features, are present as well, adding to the complexity of the scene, which appears to capture an intimate and holy moment. The cross-hatching technique is evident throughout, creating rich shadows and depth, highlighting the emotional gravitas of the gathering.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his arms resting on a surface in front of him. He has short hair covered by a large cap or hat. The man wears a loose, long-sleeved garment. He holds an artist's stylus or pen in one hand above a piece of paper, and the other hand rests on the surface.

artworks.title: Dorothée Louise Viedebandt (The Artist's Wife)
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman with a round face and soft expression. She wears a lace bonnet, a dress with a lace collar, and a scarf around her neck. The woman has a lace cuff on her sleeve and is holding a page in her left hand while her right hand is raised. She also wears drop earrings. The background is textured and monochrome, contrasting with her detailed attire.
